cases.question: Read only the supplied north elevation. Identify every drawn window, excluding doors, from left to right and count windows for each drawn floor. The full original drawing is already supplied; do not call tools. Put each window in its own directly_seen item with a tight original-image pixel box and use exactly: WINDOW floor=F1 order=N width_mm=N sill_m=N.NN head_m=N.NN. Add one directly_seen item using exactly: COUNT floor=F1 windows=N. State the visible dimension annotations in the same statements after those required fields. Use uncertain only for a quantity that truly cannot be read. Return the required observer JSON directly.
